get_logger_with_file: get a named logger with a StreamHandler and optional FileHandler for rank 0 processes
get_logger_with_level: get a named logger configured at a specific log level like DEBUG or WARNING
get_logger_distributed: get a logger that silences non-rank-0 processes in PyTorch distributed training
print_log_to_logger: print a log message to a Logger object at a specified logging level
print_log_silent: print a log message using the silent logger to suppress all output
